Episode 147. The King of the Black Sea, Gliyak (2)
As soon as Gliyak awoke, the war outside naturally ended. Kelliac and Ron had no choice but to resist the power of the chaos that had engulfed the battlefield.
Runkandel, who had been watching the situation, could no longer stand still.
As soon as Gliyak's power awakened, it spread its influence to the location where Runkandel was hiding, and escape was not an option.
Because Jin was inside. Rosa wanted to avoid Jin's death at all costs, even though Ziphel and Hyran were waiting for a double defeat.
Above all.
Those on the battlefield could intuitively perceive as soon as Gliyak awoke.
If they did not finish off the awakened King of the Black Sea here, the next step would definitely be the end of the world, or a disaster equivalent to it.
Also, Rosa and Kelliac realized why Kinzelo had not participated in this important fight until now.
'Kinzelo, they knew that was the King of the Black Sea.'
'...Now I understand. Why Ron Hyran was so seriously injured. It was because the King of the Black Sea's energy reacted to his power left in Ron's wound from the blow from Kinzelo!'
Rosa and Kelliac thought gritting their teeth.
Both were right. Knowing the identity of the white stone, Kinzelo called it a bomb, and Ron's injury deepened as it reacted with the power of Kinzelo's leader and Gliyak.
Whooosh-!
A deep blue flame was erupting from the chaos on the ground. Rosa and Kelliac sighed in relief when they saw the fire.
Because that flame was proof that Jin was still alive.
Rosa had to save Jin. Now Jin has externally become a strong successor for Joshua, and if Jin is lost, the information on Hister and Temar will become obscure again.
Kelliac also needed to save Jin. If Jin just dies, he could somehow recover the authority of Soldelet, but if Jin was 'eaten' by the King of the Black Sea, the story was completely different.
He would not be able to complete the 'Demon Stone' forever.
A storm of chaos was raging.
The Demon Stone hanging in the sky trembled with a distorted face. Kiie, Kiieieie... A low voice soaked in fear mixed with chaos and disappeared.

What the Demon Stone feared was not Ron, but Gliyak. The numerous gods sealed within it, they who made and... the fragments of the Origin Stone that they broke themselves because they couldn't handle its power.
Ssssss!
Rosa's sword, 'Rage,' dyed white and rang a sharp resonance. The aura spread like smoke protected the knights of Runkandel behind her.

Unlike Talalris, Rosa was in a state where she could fight without any restrictions. Thanks to the enlightenment she gained after Jin's declaration of lordship, she could wield a sword comparable to the current Ron.
The blazing blade cut through the chaos, and the knights of Runcandel followed her, slowly stepping forward into the storm and forming a line of defense.
In the sky, the fleet of Kelliac and Zipl was gradually descending to the ground, breaking through the chaos.
The fact that they were all moving to save Jin was undoubtedly something no one on the battlefield could have expected.
If Tes hadn't been summoned, Jin wouldn't have been able to save some of his comrades from dying.
Blue flames formed a barrier in place of the shattered white armor.
The power Tes was now wielding far surpassed the day when he single-handedly annihilated the Dark Magic Society with a single roar, but unfortunately, his opponent was Grieq.
Defense was the best they could do. They didn't know how long they could last through the unstable catalyst called chaos.
"Ha, hah...!"
Catching her breath, Talaris looked up at the front. Maintaining the white armor had reached its limit, and she sheathed her sword, trusting Jin, Tes, and the Black Knights.
At the same time, the ice broke and Stal and the Black Knights took her place, stepping forward.
'The black energy touching my blade is as heavy as a mountain. But the Archer Lord is not the kind of person to be exhausted by this much, so why is she so tired?'
Talaris spat out blood and looked at the backs of the Black Knights.
"I need time to gather my strength. Hold on somehow until then, Stal. It'll be difficult to break through the retreat anyway, so don't think about taking Jin."
"Understood, Archer Lord."

Talaris sat down, twisting her legs. Around her, about ten white dimensional gates opened, and from within them, a power far surpassing what Talaris had used so far flowed out and began to envelop her.
'Sure enough, she had power left.'
However, the situation was still not favorable. Stal and the Black Knights also felt it. The fact that the chaos was targeting Jin.
Why is it targeting me?
Jin had no time to wonder. He had already experienced through Yona that chaos above a certain level was hostile to him.
Jin moved to Stal's side.
"Twelfth Knight."
"We will defend together. Until we break through from the outside, we must hold on so that Stal's mission will not be hindered."
The blue and spiritual Braadamante, mixed with the swords of the Black Knights, began to cut through the chaos.

Murakan and Misha squeezed out their remaining strength and spread their black spears and curtains, and the comrades who still had some power left were fending off the chaos that they couldn't filter out.
Everyone was silent. Only the roar and vibration caused by the clash of the sword and the chaos echoed in Tes's flame.
Little by little.
The chaos storm was fading. However, the knights felt that it was not because the power of the Black Sea King had weakened, but because he had finally awakened and was organizing his power.
This enormous power that had dyed the battlefield in chaos in an instant was merely an eve.
The real thing was about to begin.
[Ah, ahh...]
Everyone on the battlefield could hear that voice clearly. An indescribably eerie feeling pierced the hearts of the knights and magicians.
And then the storm of chaos stopped. The chaotic energies that were swirling madly and sweeping the battlefield froze in place as if in a painting.
People could finally face the Black Sea King, Grieq, at that moment.
A dark and massive ghost.
Its crushed feet did not touch the ground but were solidly fixed in the air, and hundreds of arms attached to its body were all holding spears and swords, pointing in all directions.
Each of those arms was thick and long enough to brush against the spire of the broken Sword Emperor Castle, and their weapons blocked the whole sky.
Even the face of the devil stone looked small in comparison, and the fleet floating in front of it looked like flies.
It was hard to believe that it had sprung from that tiny stone... A massive chunk of the abyss was looking down at the humans.
However, the black pupils, like a thousand-mile abyss, were shaking unstably.
If you could withstand the dignity and take a closer look, you could find a distorted feeling somewhere in all parts of Grieq.
For some reason, it hadn't fully awakened. By nature, Grieq should not exist in this land, and he had been sealed for too long.
However, that fact couldn't be a consolation to those gathered on the battlefield. In the first place, most people didn't even realize that Grieq was released in an incomplete state.
'That's... the King of the Black Sea?'
The Five Kings of the Black Sea.
The first time Jin heard about them was when Myron Zipl was facing his end.
-I was once the lover of the witch Heluram, sharing a cup with the kings of the Tigris mountains in the west of the Black Sea...
Myron, who was trying to possess the last Demon King Orgal with dark magic during the Colon incident, chanted the spell.
Since that day, Jin had not heard any information about the King of the Black Sea anywhere. Even when Talaris explained chaos directly, she did not tell him about the Black Sea King.
However, as soon as Jin faced Grieq, he instinctively knew.
That this horrifying being was the reason his father was so obsessed with the Black Sea.
"I expected it to be part of the chaos and records left by Heluram, but Grieq!"
Misha, like Kelliac, had expected the white stone to be Heluram's chaos and records, not the Black Sea King's.
Unlike Misha, whose face had turned pale, Murakan seemed to be hearing the name Grieq for the first time. But whether he knew the name or not, that wasn't the crucial issue.
The problem they faced was survival.
[After a long sleep......my brothers, are so far...]
Kwaaaa-!
A loud noise rang from the sky before Grieq finished speaking. The Zipl fleet, except for Kozhek, malfunctioned and fired cannons.
The cannons of the airship are implemented through the magician's magic.
However, Kelliac did not issue a firing order, and the Zipl's top magicians onboard did not lose their minds in fear.
The chaotic energy that filled the entire space was causing chaos in magic devices and artifacts.
Dragons carrying artifacts described by Murakan as shackles crashed or fell, and magicians struggled to control the ship every second against the current.
Even the fired cannons disappeared blocked by the chaos in the air without even reaching Grieq.
Kelliac tried to control them using the Demon Stone, but it wasn't easy. The Demon Stone, deeply frightened, could not give Kelliac power as easily as before.
[The odious......smell of my enemy, is so strong......]
Slowly, Grieq lowered his head.
Soon, the place his eyes landed on was where Jin was standing. Jin sensed the next moment as soon as he made eye contact with him.
That countless swords and spears would rain down on him. Before the thought even ended, Jin raised his sword. Stam, the Black Knights, and his comrades took their positions.
A black blade was falling, sharper and heavier than the chaos they had struggled so hard to resist.
It was hard to accept the fact that those massive swords and spears were falling at an unreactable speed, even after experiencing it directly.

It was impossible to tell how they avoided and blocked the five consecutive attacks that fell in an instant. It would have been the end if Rosa and the Black Knights hadn't fired their sword energy, and Kelliac hadn't supported with magic.
But they were still far away. Defense had its limits, and Grieq's swords were increasingly pressuring Jin.
In a moment when he almost missed one of the continuous attacks.
Jin could confirm that one of Grieq's swords that had come close to his nose suddenly turned ash-colored.
It was Ron Hyran, he had rushed in and struck Grieq's sword.
